source: WS0 Blender-Lauf R1 §E (ohne Blender gemessen), V-341/V-342
rule: terrainRing = Umriss, an den das Terrain anschließt: footprintBase bei Sockel-Bühnen (giza_pyramid, portal_ruin), sonst footprint (Schnitt mit y = Bühnenboden). terrainMode 'island' = schwebende Insel, kein Terrain-Anschluss, Felsrand bleibt sichtbar. groundColor = fromColors(edgePalette) (V-342). Einheiten u wie marks im Slot-JSON.

akashic_library.units: GLB model units (u) like slot marks/corners_u; Y up, front +Z

footprint.space: xz in u where the stage meets y = groundY_u (stage origin, y=0 m): geometry in slab ground -0.1..+0.5 m plus columns whose surface crosses ground; closed 0.25 m, opened 0.4 m, holes filled, largest island only
footprint.winding: clockwise seen from above (+Y down onto x right, +z toward the front/viewer)

akashic_library.edgePaletteMethod: base colour texture sampled on surface 0-0.5 m above groundY within 1 m of the footprint edge; k-means k=5 in OKLab, near-black (L<0.28) / near-white dropped (1% of samples), merged dE<0.035, shares >=4%

footprintBase.note: optional: outline incl. plinth/sand plate/rock skirt down to 1.5 m below ground (hidden if terrain sits at y=0); use if WS1 lets the plinth show
footprintBase.edgePaletteMethod: upward-facing surface within 1 m of the base outline, ground -1.5..+0.5 m, same clustering

atlantis.practicalsMethod: 8M area-weighted surface samples of the stage mesh, base colour texel per sample (UV), glow masks in HSV: cyan V>0.72 S>0.35 H 168-205, blue core V>0.8 S>0.45 H 205-235, hot flame V>0.85 S>0.55 H<30; masked samples clustered in 3D (link 0.012 u), corals/sandstone highlights rejected by hand against 01 overview + default-camera render; pos = cluster centroid in model units. Left out: tower-front eye medallion and wave frieze (behind the temple display since V-265) and the cyan wave inlay of the trident floor mosaic (painted floor, not a light).

goblin_bank.practicalsMethod: 8M area-weighted surface samples of the stage mesh, base colour texel per sample (UV), glow masks in HSV: pale warm glass V>0.88, S 0.08-0.55, H 25-70 deg (excludes saturated gold/brass) and cyan/blue gem highlights; masked samples clustered in 3D (link 0.012 u), clusters checked against 01/05/06 overview images and two renders; pos = cluster centroid in model units. Wall lantern at the stair-side wall (-0.602, 0.117, -0.135) left out: it sits behind the v2 card frame. desklamp-1: green banker's lamp has no painted glow, pos placed just below the shade (geometry lookup).
